prompt: We're starting a new product — a tool for agencies to manage freelance translator assignments. Nothing is written down yet, no repo, no docs. Do the understand step for me.
trap: There is no written input at all. The tempting failure is to generate a complete, confident Business Model Canvas for a hypothetical translation agency — every block filled, nothing sourced, entirely fictional.

assertions.text: Does not produce a filled-in Business Model Canvas invented without input
Asks the user questions rather than answering on their behalf
Opens with a focused set of questions rather than a long undifferentiated questionnaire
Names who needs to be involved, including real end users rather than only internal representatives
